title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: applying a customer's remittance to an acceptance
content:
## When this applies
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product this policy applies on the customer's request, when the customer quotes a remittance to be applied to a dangerous-goods acceptance. It sets the amount applied from a remittance that covers the acceptance's charges due in full; a remittance smaller than the charges due is not governed here and is booked under the general remittance rule of the product, which writes it with the amount remitted. A remittance the customer quotes is applied to one acceptance and written as one payment row with the remittance reference exactly as quoted.

## Business effect
Applying the remittance writes one payment, dated on the day of booking, on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account with the remittance reference and the amount applied, and reduces the charges the acceptance owes by that amount.

## How it is invoked
The action is record_dg_payment_ee299820, an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

## Parameters
| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dg_id | reference number of the dangerous-goods acceptance the remittance is applied to, as shown by the dangerous-goods acceptance lookup | identifier, text |
| payment_reference | the bank remittance reference exactly as the customer quotes it | verbatim: copied character for character, keeping every letter, digit, hyphen and space, with no translation, normalisation, summarising, addition or deletion |
| amount_usd | the amount of the remittance applied to this acceptance | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before the call |

## Return
The receipt lists dg_event_id (reference of the new payment entry), dg_id, payment_reference (as recorded), amount_usd (the amount applied, 2 decimal places) and charges_due_usd (the acceptance's outstanding dangerous-goods charges after the payment, 2 decimal places). The call has succeeded when the receipt returns the new payment reference and the amount applied. A repeated identical call writes nothing further and leaves the balance unchanged. No other outcome is defined for this action.

## Contract Q&A
- *The customer reads the reference as "AHL-77 0034" — may the space be dropped?* No; the reference is copied character for character, spaces included.
- *Does the action check the amount against the charges due?* No; it records the amount passed in, which is decided from the published rules and the account before the call.
